notes: Duration is stated as "6 semesters" / "three years (six semesters)" (DAAD) and "Studierende der DHBW absolvieren ihr Hochschulstudium in nur drei Jahren" (dhbw.de general page), value 3 years. Teaching language: English only; German electives and an optional double-degree track are not counted. Tuition: the DAAD programme page lists 1,500 EUR per semester for non-EU applicants; the DHBW application page states the same amount per semester for non-EU/EEA-resident international students. This is a per-semester amount, not yearly. The 120 EUR administration fee and 12 EUR student-union fee on the DHBW application page are general enrollment fees, not tuition. Application channel: no uni-assist or university application portal is named for international applicants; the pages say international diagrams are assessed by the DHBW Central International Office and that applicants must apply to a partner company for the training contract, so applicationChannel is left out. Bachelor programmes at DHBW are generally 210 ECTS (dhbw.de general page), but the DAAD programme page states 6 semesters, which is used here.

note.fr: En tant que programme dual, vous devez d'abord trouver un partenaire (entreprise) et signer un contrat de formation/études avec lui ; l'inscription n'est possible qu'après la signature de ce contrat.
note.en: As a dual programme, you must first find a workplace training provider (company) and sign a study and workplace training contract with it; enrollment is only possible after that contract is signed.

evidence.quote: Enrollment at the university is only possible after a training contract with a workplace training provider has been signed.
